whyItMatters: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a central-package-management build that does not pin transitive versions.
actions: Pin the declaration to an exact version or to the narrowest range the project tests, and update it deliberately. Specifically: fix a central-package-management build that does not pin transitive versions.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm Directory.Packages.props no longer carries a central-package-management build that does not pin transitive versions.
